newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to firmer.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady or stronger on Tuesday, traders said.
Gasoline ended the day unchanged. Eurograde barges traded as high as $208 fob ARA.
Naphtha was steady too. Little product was seen on offer but buying interest was lacklustre.
Gas oil ended stronger higher with of fair amount of buying in the heating oil barge market despite fairly high premiums.
Fuel oil barges gained about $1 with deals done at $112 fob ARA. One buyer was noticeably active and bunkering was good.
